test: read-only build gate telemetry on real CAN
root_cause: explorer_reference.h: OTA_EXPLORER_STORAGE_TRUSTED defaults to OTA_EXPLORER_UPDATE_CAPABLE (0 in the diagnostics READONLY target); BSP then forces config->storage_verified=0, so ota_stm32_ports_init() computes storage_ready=0 and stm32_eeprom.c eeprom_read() returns -1 unconditionally. metadata_load() therefore fails, append_did(UDS_DID_UPDATE_STATUS) returns -3 and UDS replies NRC 0x72. This is deliberate gate behaviour, not a defect.

expected.0x34: 7F 34 22 (conditions not correct) because programming_allowed = OTA_ENABLE_FLASHING && storage_ready = 0
